$comment: The dev server fronts Kestrel so the browser sees one origin, which the hub needs: a
cross-origin websocket would need CORS on the server that production will not want.
changeOrigin is false on purpose. The server builds the join URL the QR code encodes from the
Host header of the request, because it is the only thing that knows an address a phone can
actually reach. Rewriting the header to localhost would put localhost in the QR code, and the
phone scanning it would be pointed at itself.
